description: Find current Simcardo eSIM plans for a dated trip. Use when the traveler needs a plan that covers a destination, trip duration, data allowance or tethering requirement. Return verified matches with total price, activation terms and a direct product link, or explain why no plan can be confirmed.

additional_destinations.description: Add other country codes to find one eSIM with verified coverage in every listed country for the full date range.

currency.description: Storefront currency code, e.g. EUR, USD, JPY, THB or CZK.

data_gb.description: Total requested GB for the entire trip; 1 GB = 1000 MB. Provide this OR usage_profile.

destination.description: Uppercase country or territory code, e.g. TH, JP, US, BR. Ask for clarification rather than guessing.

hotspot_required.description: True requires explicit supplier confirmation that tethering is allowed for the exact plan.

include_regional.description: For a single destination, also consider packages with verified coverage there. Defaults to dedicated country plans only.

language.description: Storefront language for localized destination names, price display and links. Reply to the traveler in their language.

start_date.description: First local calendar day of coverage (YYYY-MM-DD).

usage_profile.description: Choose this when the traveler described usage rather than specifying GB. The catalogue estimates the required GB. Do not send both.
